algorithm: iterative optimization (gradient-based sphere-approximated pose optimization) plus a generative model (conditional VAE, DexSimple) data engine with simulator-based filtering/debiasing
hand: Shadow Hand (22 DoF, main grasp-synthesis benchmark); also Inspire Hand and Ability Hand (6-DoF parameterized) for the 1B-demo dataset
sim: Isaac Gym (DexGraspNet benchmark); ManiSkill/SAPIEN (dataset generation and filtering)
success_criterion: lifting: lift object to 0.4m height while maintaining hand-object contact; articulation: increase joint angle of an articulated object by 0.5 rad while maintaining contact
headline_metric: grasp-synthesis Success Rate (SR) on the DexGraspNet benchmark (Shadow Hand, Isaac Gym)
headline_value: DexSimple (w/opt, no filter) SR 86.0%, Q1 0.125, Pen 0.13 vs. UGG (w/opt) SR 64.1%; with a learned filter DexSimple SR 92.6% vs. UGG 72.7% (Table II); real-robot: DexSimple 96% mean success (5 trials x 10 unseen objects) vs. DexSampler baseline 58% (Sec. VI)
human_data: DexYCB (20 objects, ~500 trajectories/hand) and ARCTIC (10 articulation objects, 301 trajectories total), used only as comparison baselines, not as Dex1B's own training data; Dex1B itself is purely synthetic, no human motion
note_gaps: the exact scaling-curve values (Fig. 8) are qualitative only in the parsed text, no numeric table given; the '22%' headline improvement is a percentage-point gap, not a relative percentage, flagged as ambiguous by the note
